setup_span_masked_lm_task: setup a span masked language modeling task using SpanMaskedLMTask.setup_task with a config and data paths
load_span_masked_lm_dataset: load a span masked LM dataset split using SpanMaskedLMTask.load_dataset for train or validation splits
build_inference_dataset: build an inference dataset from source tokens using SpanMaskedLMTask.build_dataset_for_inference with token blocks
configure_span_masked_lm: configure span masked LM hyperparameters like noise density and mean span length via SpanMaskedLMConfig
get_max_positions: get the max source and target positions allowed by the SpanMaskedLMTask using max_positions
